scripts.copy:history: mkdir old-history && cp -r allure-report/history old-history/ || true
scripts.allure:history: mkdir -p allure-results && cp -r old-history/history allure-results/ || true
scripts.test:report: npm run test:execution && npm run allure:open
scripts.test:execution: npm run delete:history && npm run copy:history && npm run allure:clear && npm run allure:executor && npm run cy:run && npm run allure:history && npm run allure:generate
scripts.e2e:history: npm run delete:history && npm run copy:history
scripts.e2e:configuration: npm run allure:clear && npm run e2e:executor
scripts.e2e:results: npm run allure:history && npm run allure:generate
